styleTail: Style: technical SaaS register (Stripe/Linear lineage), light mode only, white cards with 1px #E2E8F0 borders on #F4F6F9 background, ink text #0F172A, single indigo #4F46E5 accent for primary actions and active nav, status colors green #059669 / amber #F59E0B / slate #334155 / sky #0284C7 / orange #C2410C, 8px radii, 8px spacing grid, 3px colored left status bar on cards, monospace for unit codes, tabular numerals, VND money format like "1.150.000 ₫", English UI.

screens.title: Login
screens.prompt: Generate screen: Login for "StorageHub", a self-storage rental web app. Centered white card (max 400px wide) on the light grey canvas. StorageHub logo mark + wordmark above the card. Fields with visible labels: Email, Password. Primary indigo button "Sign in" full width. Text link "Forgot password?" — also render the forgot-password modal open beside the card: modal contains email field, secondary "Send reset link" button, and confirmation copy "If an account for that email exists, a reset link has been sent." Below the card a quiet meta line: "Staff and manager accounts are provisioned by administration." and a link "New here? Create an account".

screens.title: Register
screens.prompt: Generate screen: Register (customer self-signup) for "StorageHub". Primary indigo button "Create account". Quiet meta note: "Self-registration is for customers. Storage staff and managers receive accounts from administration."
